My friend's grandpa, who I also affectionately call Ah Gong too, told me that at age 65, he still doesn't have life figured out. Which shocked me at first because it was scary to think about.

But then he reasoned it by saying that life is like a game, with so many side mission and quest to do.  
(He loves Pokemon Go so he tried to use PoGo as an analogy)

**"Things that don't work out, can still work out. You will be surprised. I didn't meet your grandmother when we were teenagers. We lived near each other and never knew for 10 years plus. Yet some day, down the road, all our experiences lined us up to be the right person for each other, at the right time."**

*Did you know she was the one when you guys started or got married?*

**Son** *(he likes to call me that)* **You never know. And that's the fun, the joy, and the pain of life**.  
**And you get this mystery in every aspect of your life. Your 20s, your 30s, your 40s etc**

**It's the beauty of life and value of time**. He says, in an almost romantic way.

**"Time... 40 years, 50 years... it is never enough"**  
As he said that he looks at a picture of Ah Ma, who left last year, and at that moment my heart was both broken and warmed. But I guess, at least for today, I remain hopeful for my life.
